headline: Assurant (AIZ) Appoints Kelli Ertel To Expanded Leadership Role
summary: Assurant appointed Kelli Ertel as Chief Communications Officer and Chief of Staff. Ertel will also join Assurant's Management Committee as part of this expanded role. The appointment is expected to shape the company’s communication approach, brand positioning, and internal culture. For investors tracking Assurant, ticker NYSE:AIZ, this leadership change comes with the stock recently closing at $276.94.
